title: Fix category select overlap and add bilingual §13b reverse-charge note (UI + invoice preview)

requirements.summary: Prevent overlap in the “Service/Product Category” select so the chosen value stays readable across viewport sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Transaction Details step, the “Service/Product Category” select shows the current selection without text overlapping the dropdown chevron, label, or adjacent UI.
Long option labels (e.g., “Consulting / freelance”) remain readable via truncation/wrapping rules without causing overlap or layout breakage.
Verified on both desktop and mobile viewport widths.

file_operations.description: Adjust the SelectTrigger/SelectValue styling for the “Service/Product Category” control to reserve space for the chevron and prevent text overlap (e.g., enforce text-left, proper padding-right, and truncation/wrapping behavior suitable for narrow/mobile layouts) without modifying vendor UI components under frontend/src/components/ui.

Add/adjust global utility styles (as needed) to support safe select-value rendering (e.g., reusable class for truncation/wrapping and chevron-safe padding) while keeping vendor UI components untouched.

requirements.summary: Show an exact bilingual §13b reverse-charge comment under the reverse-charge result when VAT is 0%.
acceptanceCriteria: If the calculation scenario is reverse-charge (VAT 0%), the UI shows the German line followed immediately by the English line underneath.
If the scenario is not reverse-charge, this bilingual §13b comment is not shown.
The text matches exactly (including punctuation, capitalization, and the § symbol).

file_operations.description: When result indicates reverse-charge with 0% VAT, render a two-line note directly under the reverse-charge output (in the legal note area): line 1 exactly “Steuerschuldnerschaft des Leistungsempfängers (§13b UStG)”, line 2 exactly “Tax liability of the recipient of services (§13b UStG)”. Ensure it is not rendered for other scenarios and does not change calculation logic.

requirements.summary: Include the same bilingual §13b reverse-charge comment in the invoice preview legal VAT note for reverse-charge (0%) invoices.
acceptanceCriteria: For reverse-charge invoices, the Legal Note section in the invoice preview contains both lines in the specified order, separated by a visible line break.
For non-reverse-charge invoices, the invoice legal note behavior remains unchanged.
The text matches exactly (including punctuation, capitalization, and the § symbol).

file_operations.description: Update the auto legal VAT text mapping so that for the reverse-charge scenario it returns the required bilingual §13b text with a clear line break between the German and English lines, while leaving other scenarios unchanged.

Ensure the invoice HTML renders the reverse-charge legal note with a visible line break for the bilingual §13b text (e.g., by supporting HTML line breaks from getAutoLegalVatText or by applying appropriate rendering/whitespace rules in the Legal Note section), without altering invoice behavior for non-reverse-charge scenarios.
